# Ambient Thread Foundation

> A nonprofit organization making everyday listening easier, more accessible, and more inclusive for people with different hearing and auditory needs — including people who are single-sided deaf, hard of hearing, or sound-sensitive.

Website: https://ambientthread.org

## Who we are

- Registered New Mexico non-profit organization (founded August 5, 2026). Federal 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status is pending with the IRS. EIN: 42-4819969.
- Founded by Melissa Burns, who became single-sided deaf at age 37 after surgery to remove an acoustic neuroma in 2024.
- Remote organization. Mailing address: 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE, Ste N, Albuquerque, NM 87110, USA.

## What we offer

- An accessibility-focused iOS audio app, expected in 2027: personalized sound routing and listening balance using standard iOS devices and the headphones people already own — no specialized, costly audio hardware required. Built for asymmetrical listening, easier conversation-following, situational awareness, and comfort in loud spaces.
- Education, peer-informed support, and resource navigation for the sound-sensitive community.
- Volunteer, advisory, and leadership-pipeline opportunities (remote-friendly).

Important: the app is intended for general wellness and everyday audio customization. It is not a medical device, hearing aid, or treatment for hearing loss.

## Pricing and donations

- The foundation's programs and website are free to use. App pricing has not been announced; affordability is a stated goal.
- Donations are processed through Zeffy with zero platform or processing fees, so 100% of each gift goes to the mission: https://www.zeffy.com/en-US/donation-form/donate-to-pay-our-developer-and-backend-support
